description: The file is an extension of the VoiceWakeOverlayController class, providing methods to manage overlay window presentation, configuration, and UI updates in a macOS application. It primarily handles window creation, display logic, height measurement, and dismissal positioning for a voice wake overlay interface.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays the voice wake overlay window, setting up the view hierarchy and overlay panel, handling first-time presentation, and updating visibility state.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures the overlay window if it does not already exist, setting up the hosting view with the overlay SwiftUI view.

methods.name: bringToFrontIfVisible
methods.description: Brings the overlay window to front if it is currently visible.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the target frame for positioning the overlay window on the screen.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the overlay window's frame to the target frame, optionally animating the transition.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the required height of the overlay content based on its attributed text content.

methods.name: dismissTargetFrame
methods.description: Determines and returns the target frame for dismissing or animating the overlay, based on the dismissal reason and outcome.
